paperTitle: PriorVLA: Prior-Preserving Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
organization: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences / Dexmal / Zhongguancun Academy / Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

benchmarks.label: RoboTwin 2.0
benchmarks.detail: Suites: standard Easy 77 · standard Hard 53 | Tasks: 13 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks including Grab Roller, Handover Mic, Lift Pot, Open Laptop, Pick Dual Bottles, Place Object Basket, Stack Blocks Two, and Stack Bowls Two | Table 1 and Table 2 | Notes: Standard training with 50 clean demonstrations per task and 300 evaluation trials per setting. The paper reports Easy and Hard aggregates separately; overall is their mean.

benchmarks.label: LIBERO
benchmarks.detail: Suites: libero spatial 99.4 · libero object 99.8 · libero goal 99.4 · libero long 97.6 | Table 3 | Notes: Four standard LIBERO suites; the paper reports 99.1% average success.
